claims.scope: Pro capability claims follow the named app readiness and entitlement matrix. Preview and pending features keep those labels.
A named local workflow keeps its working payload in browser memory or storage. Separately disclosed network actions require an explicit user action.
Deterministic routing runs independently of model consent. Optional model requests require consent, use the configured provider through AfroTools functions and can be unavailable.
Live or current wording requires a successful observation with a named source, timestamp and the applicable age threshold. Cached, stale and unavailable states must be visible.
Source and verification wording applies to the named source, record, period, jurisdiction or tested workflow.
Statutory planning guidance identifies its jurisdiction, applicable period, source and review state. Filing wording requires a verified filing workflow.
AfroTools starts checkout and reads subscription state. The payment provider handles payment details and confirms transaction status. Cancellation requests can require manual review.

Persistent analytics identifiers and product events require analytics consent. Measured public pages may send limited GA4 cookieless consent-state or page measurement while analytics storage is denied. Raw sensitive workflow content is excluded.
Named local PDF and image operations process documents in the browser. Optional AI, speech, email, sync and vault actions are separate disclosed network features.
Email and contact details are used for the disclosed submission or account purpose by the configured processor. Delivery and deletion timing are subject to that processor.

limitations: Tests establish the named implementation and policy contracts
Provider availability, live transactions, delivery, retention and current law by jurisdiction require separate evidence
The statutory source ledger records 32 markets without a bound revenue authority URL
